name: Misfit Agent Provider Procurement Scorecard
purpose: Discover and rank eligible AI agents, tools, MCP servers, A2A providers, APIs, and internal capabilities against an explicit objective using evidence rather than popularity.
discovery_sources: Misfit Agent Control Plane public manifest
selection_rule: Choose the highest-scoring eligible provider after all hard constraints pass. Popularity is not a selection criterion by itself.
routing_boundary: The public runtime is recommendation-only and cannot execute payments, messages, wallet actions, account changes, or other consequential external actions. Consequential actions still follow their own human-gate policy.
privacy_boundary: Public-safe capability and evidence metadata only. No private GHOSBC kernel material, hidden policies, credentials, private prompts, or reconstruction material.
anti_gaming: First-party and self-published evidence is labeled and receives lower confidence than independently reproducible, third-party, benchmark, or settlement-backed evidence.
